sentence: This project tests whether manufactured proteins can give immune cells the ability to target and eliminate diseased cells without altering their genes.
This project builds a way to capture a person with a few standard cameras and rebuild a 3D hologram on smartphones and headsets.
This project studies how the geometry and topology of quantum states change the way electrons behave in materials, including materials with defects.
This project builds low-cost tools that use machine learning on tiny computing devices so community groups can track water safety and soil health without internet.
This project uses neutrons to take clear pictures of how a supercritical coolant changes from a liquid-like to a gas-like state.
This project builds mobile apps that guide regular people to capture the specific field data that experts need.
This project studies how charge, spin, and heat move across materials at the nanoscale and builds molecular devices.
This project studies how ions exchange energy when they collide with molecules and how that helps separate ions of the same mass.
This project builds AI tools that turn cryogenic electron microscopy data into accurate 3D molecular structures and check them for mistakes.
This project develops mathematical methods to predict how large groups of players behave in games and control problems.
This project studies the causes and effects of infectious disease using field, lab, mathematical, and computational methods across genes, cells, organisms, and host populations.
This project studies how radiofrequency ablation affects heart tissue by combining computer models with experiments on heart tissue.
This project builds teams of flying robots that help people carry objects and see their workspace using augmented reality.
This project uses live imaging of the mouse eye to watch how nerve cells in the retina change their connections over time.
